bio.zh: 签下第一份版权协议之前，先把那盒游戏在自家桌上跑了十四局。现在负责选题、版权谈判与整体产品判断——公司里唯一一件他不肯授权出去的事，是决定我们做什么、不做什么。
bio.en: Played the first title fourteen times on his own table before signing anything. Runs acquisition, licence negotiation and overall product judgement — the one call he will not delegate is what we take on and what we turn down.

bio.zh: 术语表在译者动笔之前就要定稿——这条规矩是她立的。带队完成《阿格莫尼亚》十余万字战役文本的中文改写，坚持规则书按中文玩家的阅读顺序重排，而不是照抄原书版式。
bio.en: The rule that the glossary is locked before a translator starts is hers. Led the Chinese rewrite of Agemonia's campaign text and insists rulebooks are re-sequenced for how Chinese players actually read, not copied page for page.

bio.zh: 十年印制与配件工程背景。白盒打样、卡牌覆膜、木质件色号、外盒抗压，全部经他手过一遍；他的口头禅是「原版规格是底线，不是上限」。
bio.en: Ten years in print and component engineering. White-box prototypes, card lamination, wood stain matching and box crush tests all cross his desk. His line: the original spec is the floor, not the ceiling.

bio.zh: 《冥烛》的机制作者。命运骰系统与八卦解谜都出自她的原型；她认为一个机制如果需要三段话才能讲清楚，那就是还没设计完。
bio.en: Designer of Netherworld Candle. Both the Destiny Dice system and the Bagua puzzles started as her prototypes. Her test: if a mechanism needs three paragraphs to explain, it isn't finished.

bio.zh: 负责原创作品的视觉体系与中文版的美术落地。她的工作里最难的一部分不是画,是让一套为拉丁字母设计的版式在中文排布下依然成立。
bio.en: Owns the visual system on originals and the art adaptation on licensed editions. The hard part of the job is not illustration — it is making a layout designed around Latin type still work set in Chinese.

bio.zh: 两次自营众筹的操盘人,53 个解锁目标全部按期兑现。同时负责实体渠道与经销商关系——他坚持交付日期一旦公布就不再改动。
bio.en: Ran both self-managed campaigns and delivered all 53 stretch goals on schedule. Also owns retail and distribution accounts. His rule: once a fulfilment date is published, it does not move.

bio.zh: 海外发行商的第一联络人。合同、授权范围、样书与展会日程都由她跟进——工作日 48 小时内回复的承诺,是她在兑现。
bio.en: First point of contact for publishers abroad. Contracts, territory scope, review copies and convention scheduling all run through her — the 48-hour reply promise is hers to keep.

bio.zh: 组织线下试玩会与三轮真人校对。每年两百多款候选里,哪几款「跑完十局还想再来一局」,数据来自他的场子。
bio.en: Runs the demo nights and the three rounds of played proofing. Of the two hundred-odd candidates a year, the data on which ones survive ten plays and still get asked for comes from his tables.
